blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Let's split one more bottle of wine.
exercises.why: **распить → разопьём** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.

exercises.prompt: Let's bury the hatchet.
exercises.why: **закопать → закопаем** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.

exercises.prompt: Let's get drunk today!
exercises.why: **напиться → напьёмся** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.

exercises.q: Кто не курит и не пьёт, тот здоровеньким ___ (помереть).
exercises.prompt: Those who don't smoke or drink will die healthy.
exercises.why: **помереть → помрёт** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: You'll feel better in no time.
exercises.why: **почувствовать → почувствуешь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Please, where's the closest travel agency?
exercises.why: **простить → Простите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I'll carry this suitcase for you.
exercises.why: **понести → понесу** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Дождик, дождик, перестань. Я ___ (поехать) в Аристань.
exercises.prompt: Rain, rain, go away. Come again another day.
exercises.why: **поехать → поеду** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: These birds don't migrate.
exercises.why: **мигрировать → мигрируют** — present-type form, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Я сказал Мэри, что ___ (купить) ей другой скейтборд.
exercises.prompt: I told Mary that I'd buy her another skateboard.
exercises.why: **купить → куплю** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I can't wait for Valentine's Day!
exercises.why: **дождаться → дождусь** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Джон за словом в карман не ___ (полезть).
exercises.prompt: John has a ready tongue.
exercises.why: **полезть → полезет** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I get off at the next station.
exercises.why: **выходить → выхожу** — present-type form, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: Won't you sit on my knee?
exercises.why: **посидеть → Посидишь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я был почти уверен, что ты ___ (сказать) что-нибудь этакое.
exercises.prompt: I was almost certain you'd say something like that.
exercises.why: **сказать → скажешь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Несоблюдение этих предписаний ___ (повлечь) за собой штрафные санкции.
exercises.prompt: Failure to observe these regulations will result in penalties.
exercises.why: **повлечь → повлечёт** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Who finances the Islamic State?
exercises.why: **финансировать → финансирует** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Я ___ (посадить) у себя в саду акацию.
exercises.prompt: I'm going to plant an acacia tree in my garden.
exercises.why: **посадить → посажу** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: "Ах, я умираю, - сказала Пьеретта, падая на колени. - Кто меня ___ (спасти)?"
exercises.prompt: "Ah! I'm dying," said Pierrette, falling to her knees. "Who will save me?"
exercises.why: **спасти → спасёт** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Can you break a five dollar bill?
exercises.why: **разменять → разменяешь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
